strings.subtitle: — Tlapololistli āmox —
strings.dnd_unavailable: Ahmo hueliti tikhuica. Xiktequipano in tlatequipanalli tlahtzintlan.
strings.shred_button: T L A P O L O
strings.ssd_warning:
Tlaīxnāmiqui! Ipan SSD, in tlahcuiloliztli ahmo tlatequitiltia tlapololiztli īca TRIM.
Inīn tlatequipanalli īca HDD.
strings.confirm_text:
In āmox "{name}" mochīhuaz īhuān mopopoloz.

Ticchīhuaz?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
This is a shortcut (.lnk). Only the shortcut itself will be destroyed.

The target file it points to will remain intact.

Continue?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
This is a network drive (\\server\share).
Sector overwrite does not guarantee destruction — the server may have snapshots, deduplication or CoW.

Continue?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
This is a removable drive (USB stick / external HDD).
The controller may keep old blocks in reserve.

Continue?
strings.report_limits:
• NTFS occē tlamatiliztli ātli (ADS) ahmo mochīhua.
• USN āmoxtli ahmo mopopoloa.
• Ēhuatl īxiptla īhuān mixtlān tlanahuatilli
  (OneDrive īhuān occē) ahmo mopatlaliz.
strings.status_full: In tlahtōllōtl ōmochīhualo nochi īca zero. Ahmo hueliti mocentlālia — in tlatequipanalli quīz īca zero.
strings.status_fast: Tzontecon, cuitlapīlli īhuān 4 MB tlahpīlli ōmochīhualo. In occē ahmo ōtlachīhualo, īpampa in tlaāhuiliztli, nochi mocentlāliztli īca tlatequipanalli ahmo hueliti. Īca tlaīxtlahcuilōlli tlatequipanoa īca NOCHI moda.
strings.status_empty: In āmox icnotl ōcatca, tlahcuiloliztli ahmo ōmonequi. Ōmopopoloh.
strings.error_permission: Ahmo hueliti nimocalaquia in āmox. Hueliti ōtlapohualoc occē tlatequipanalli. Xiktzacua īhuān xikchīhua occē.
strings.error_not_found: In āmox ahmo ōmochīuh. Hueliti ōmopopoloh.
strings.error_is_symlink: Inīn īxnextīlli cahuīyoh. In cahuīyoh ahmo hueliti mopopoloa — in tlanequīlli āmox cualli mochīhuaz.
strings.error_reparse: Inīn ōtlacuilōlli āmox (OneDrive nozo occē). In tlamatiliztli īpan mixtli, ahmo īpan tlahcuilōlli — nican ahmo tlein mopopoloz.
strings.error_not_file: Inīn ahmo āmox (caxitl nozo occē). Xikcāhua āmox.
strings.error_hardlinks: Inīn āmox quipiya occē huēyi cahuīyoh ({n} nochi). In huēyi cahuīyoh ahmo quipiya tlayacānqui — nochi tōcāitl mochīhua. Intlā tikpopoloz īca in āxcān ohtli, in tlamatiliztli mochīhuaz īhuān motzontzontequiz 32 byte, īpampa in tepitzīlli hueliti mocentlāliz īca occē cahuīyoh. Xikpopoloa nochi cahuīyoh achto.
strings.error_compressed:
In āmox ōmotzontzon īhuān ōmotlāīxnextili. Tlahcuiloliztli īca zero ahmo tlatequitiltia tlapololiztli in huēhcāuh tlamatiliztli īpampa NTFS quipiya occē ohtli.

Xikquīxtia in tlaīxnextīlli: xiktēca īyīcampa → Tlamatiliztli → Huēyi → xikquīxtia in machiyōtl "Tzontzontli" īhuān/nozo "Ichtacatl". Niman xiktlālia SHREDDER occē.
